en: A monochrome postcard showing an interior museum view with ancient Greek architecture. In the background there is a reconstructed small temple-like building with a sculpted pediment and two caryatid statues as columns. In the foreground stands a statue of a horse on a pedestal. The space is labeled at the bottom in French and Greek, indicating it is the reconstructed Treasury of Cnidus in the Delphi Museum.
